title: 污水熱回收熱泵~Wastewater heat-recovery heat pumps
focus: 污水熱源、熱泵循環與系統能效~Wastewater heat sources, heat-pump cycles and system efficiency
summary: 以「污水熱源、熱泵循環與系統能效」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。~Follow wastewater heat sources, heat-pump cycles and system efficiency through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

units.title: 熱源時序與需求~Source timing and demand
units.mechanism: 污水流量、溫度與用熱需求需同步；平均有熱不代表尖峰時可用。~Synchronize sewage flow, temperature and demand; average heat does not ensure peak availability.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：available heat=m cp DeltaT;m=10;cp=4.18;DeltaT=3；計算 10*4.18*3 = 125.4 kW。適用限制：可提取熱量的顯熱估算。~Original hypothetical teaching example: available heat=m cp DeltaT;m=10;cp=4.18;DeltaT=3; calculation 10*4.18*3 = 125.4 kW. Applicability: Sensible estimate of extractable heat.
units.verify: 疊合24小時熱源和需求曲線。~Overlay24-hour source and demand profiles.
units.failure: 用日均流量選設備可能漏掉夜間低流量。~Sizing from daily mean flow misses low-flow hours.
units.misconception: 污水平均溫度足夠就代表全天都有相同熱量。~Adequate mean sewage temperature ensures equal heat all day.
units.practice: 在「熱源時序與需求」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 125.4 kW，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「用日均流量選設備可能漏掉夜間低流量。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for source timing and demand, first reproduce 125.4 kW, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Sizing from daily mean flow misses low-flow hours." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 二次隔離迴路~Secondary isolation loop
units.mechanism: 污水與建築迴路以換熱器分隔，降低污染交叉風險但增加溫差與泵功。~An exchanger separates sewage from building loops, reducing cross-contamination pathways while adding approach temperature and pumping.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：approach=Tsource-Tsecondary;18-15；計算 18-15 = 3 K。適用限制：端點溫差示例。~Original hypothetical teaching example: approach=Tsource-Tsecondary;18-15; calculation 18-15 = 3 K. Applicability: Illustrative endpoint approach.
units.verify: 改變換熱器面積比較接近溫差。~Vary exchanger area and compare approach temperature.
units.failure: 直接把污水當建築循環水會破壞隔離假設。~Directly using sewage as building loop water defeats isolation.
units.misconception: 增加隔離換熱器不會改變任何能耗或溫差。~An isolation exchanger changes neither energy use nor temperatures.
units.practice: 在「二次隔離迴路」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 3 K，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「直接把污水當建築循環水會破壞隔離假設。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for secondary isolation loop, first reproduce 3 K, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Directly using sewage as building loop water defeats isolation." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 熱泵能量守恆~Heat-pump energy balance
units.mechanism: 加熱輸出等於取自熱源的熱加上壓縮機功；不能將COP當熱效率百分比。~Heating output equals source heat plus compressor work; COP is not an efficiency percentage.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：Qhot=Qsource+W;120+40；計算 120+40 = 160 kW。適用限制：穩態且其他熱損忽略。~Original hypothetical teaching example: Qhot=Qsource+W;120+40; calculation 120+40 = 160 kW. Applicability: Steady state neglecting other heat losses.
units.verify: 檢查熱源側、熱端及電表三項是否閉合。~Check closure of source, sink and electricity measurements.
units.failure: 以COP大於1判斷違反守恆是把移熱與發熱混同。~Calling COP above1 a violation confuses heat transfer with heat generation.
units.misconception: 熱泵輸出熱量只能小於輸入電功。~Heat-pump heat output must be smaller than electrical input.
units.practice: 在「熱泵能量守恆」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 160 kW，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「以COP大於1判斷違反守恆是把移熱與發熱混同。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for heat-pump energy balance, first reproduce 160 kW, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Calling COP above1 a violation confuses heat transfer with heat generation." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 加熱COP~Heating COP
units.mechanism: COP以有用供熱除所需功，邊界須說明包含哪些泵與輔機。~COP divides useful heat by required work; specify included pumps and auxiliaries.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：COP=Qhot/W;160/40；計算 160/40 = 4 ratio。適用限制：僅壓縮機功的教學邊界。~Original hypothetical teaching example: COP=Qhot/W;160/40; calculation 160/40 = 4 ratio. Applicability: Teaching boundary including compressor work only.
units.verify: 把循環泵納入後重算系統COP。~Include circulation pumps and recalculate system COP.
units.failure: 報壓縮機COP卻聲稱全系統性能會高估效益。~Reporting compressor COP as system performance overstates benefit.
units.misconception: 任何設備標示的COP都使用同一能量邊界。~Every stated COP uses the same boundary.
units.practice: 在「加熱COP」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 4 ratio，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「報壓縮機COP卻聲稱全系統性能會高估效益。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for heating cop, first reproduce 4 ratio, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Reporting compressor COP as system performance overstates benefit." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 溫升與卡諾上限~Temperature lift and Carnot limit
units.mechanism: 理想上限取決於絕對溫度和溫升；實際壓縮機與換熱不可逆使COP較低。~The ideal bound depends on absolute temperatures and lift; irreversibility lowers actual COP.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：COP_Carnot=Th/(Th-Tc);Th=323K;Tc=283K；計算 323/(323-283) = 8.075 ratio。適用限制：可逆理論上限，非設備預測。~Original hypothetical teaching example: COP_Carnot=Th/(Th-Tc);Th=323K;Tc=283K; calculation 323/(323-283) = 8.075 ratio. Applicability: Reversible upper bound, not equipment prediction.
units.verify: 把熱端升高10K，觀察理想上限變化。~Raise sink temperature10K and observe the ideal bound.
units.failure: 以攝氏計算卡諾COP會失去絕對溫標基礎。~Celsius in Carnot COP loses the absolute-temperature basis.
units.misconception: 卡諾COP就是可直接達到的實際設備COP。~Carnot COP is directly achievable equipment COP.
units.practice: 在「溫升與卡諾上限」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 8.075 ratio，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「以攝氏計算卡諾COP會失去絕對溫標基礎。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for temperature lift and carnot limit, first reproduce 8.075 ratio, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Celsius in Carnot COP loses the absolute-temperature basis." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 污垢熱阻~Fouling resistance
units.mechanism: 污垢增加熱阻而降低總傳熱係數；壓差與熱阻可能同時變化但不是同一指標。~Fouling adds thermal resistance and lowers U; pressure and thermal resistance may change together but are different measures.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：Udirty=1/(1/Uclean+Rf);Uclean=1000;Rf=0.0005；計算 1/(1/1000+0.0005) = 666.667 W/m2/K。適用限制：固定清潔側熱阻。~Original hypothetical teaching example: Udirty=1/(1/Uclean+Rf);Uclean=1000;Rf=0.0005; calculation 1/(1/1000+0.0005) = 666.667 W/m2/K. Applicability: Fixed clean-side resistance.
units.verify: 在相同流量比較清洗前後UA及壓差。~Compare UA and pressure before/after cleaning at equal flow.
units.failure: 只依壓差低就判斷傳熱良好可能漏掉薄污膜。~Low pressure loss can miss thermally resistive thin films.
units.misconception: 沒有壓差上升就一定沒有傳熱污損。~No pressure rise means no thermal fouling.
units.practice: 在「污垢熱阻」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 666.667 W/m2/K，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只依壓差低就判斷傳熱良好可能漏掉薄污膜。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for fouling resistance, first reproduce 666.667 W/m2/K, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Low pressure loss can miss thermally resistive thin films." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 換熱面積量級~Heat-transfer area estimate
units.mechanism: UA與溫差推動決定換熱量；面積估算需保留污垢與流態假設。~UA and temperature difference set heat transfer; retain fouling and flow assumptions in area estimates.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：A=Q/(U LMTD);Q=120000W;U=600;LMTD=5K；計算 120000/(600*5) = 40 m2。適用限制：定U的量級估算。~Original hypothetical teaching example: A=Q/(U LMTD);Q=120000W;U=600;LMTD=5K; calculation 120000/(600*5) = 40 m2. Applicability: Order-of-magnitude estimate with fixed U.
units.verify: 把污垢後U減半，重算面積需求。~Halve fouled U and recalculate required area.
units.failure: 只用清潔U會低估運行後所需面積。~Clean U alone understates operating area needs.
units.misconception: 換熱面積與污垢狀態完全無關。~Heat-transfer area is unrelated to fouling.
units.practice: 在「換熱面積量級」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 40 m2，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只用清潔U會低估運行後所需面積。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for heat-transfer area estimate, first reproduce 40 m2, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Clean U alone understates operating area needs." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 泵功與系統COP~Pumping and system COP
units.mechanism: 熱源輸送距離和壓降會降低淨效益；小系統的輔機占比可能很高。~Source distance and pressure loss reduce net benefit; auxiliaries can dominate small systems.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：COPsystem=Qhot/(Wcomp+Wpumps);160/(40+8)；計算 160/(40+8) = 3.33333 ratio。適用限制：同一時段的穩態能量。~Original hypothetical teaching example: COPsystem=Qhot/(Wcomp+Wpumps);160/(40+8); calculation 160/(40+8) = 3.33333 ratio. Applicability: Steady energy over the same interval.
units.verify: 比較遠近熱源的泵電與供熱量。~Compare pumping and heat delivery for near and distant sources.
units.failure: 忽略抽水電力可能把能量搬運成本藏起來。~Ignoring pumping hides the energy cost of transport.
units.misconception: 污水熱源免費就代表供熱完全不用電。~A free sewage heat source means heating needs no electricity.
units.practice: 在「泵功與系統COP」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 3.33333 ratio，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「忽略抽水電力可能把能量搬運成本藏起來。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for pumping and system cop, first reproduce 3.33333 ratio, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Ignoring pumping hides the energy cost of transport." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 季節績效~Seasonal performance
units.mechanism: 季節績效用累積熱量除累積電量，不能把每小時COP作無權平均。~Seasonal performance divides accumulated heat by electricity, not an unweighted average of hourly COPs.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：SPF=(Q1+Q2)/(E1+E2);1000,500,250,200；計算 (1000+500)/(250+200) = 3.33333 ratio。適用限制：兩期間示例，含所列輔機。~Original hypothetical teaching example: SPF=(Q1+Q2)/(E1+E2);1000,500,250,200; calculation (1000+500)/(250+200) = 3.33333 ratio. Applicability: Two-period example including stated auxiliaries.
units.verify: 比較直接平均4與2.5和能量加權結果。~Compare the simple average of4 and2.5 with the energy-weighted result.
units.failure: 高COP低負荷時段等權計入會高估全年表現。~Equal weighting of high-COP low-load periods overstates annual performance.
units.misconception: 季節COP就是每小時COP的算術平均。~Seasonal COP is the arithmetic mean of hourly COP.
units.practice: 在「季節績效」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 3.33333 ratio，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「高COP低負荷時段等權計入會高估全年表現。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for seasonal performance, first reproduce 3.33333 ratio, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Equal weighting of high-COP low-load periods overstates annual performance." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 熱源影響與異常回退~Source impacts and fault fallback
units.mechanism: 取熱會降低污水溫度，可能影響下游處理；異常時需回退到已定義的教學安全狀態。~Heat extraction cools sewage and may affect downstream treatment; faults need a defined fallback state in the teaching model.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：DeltaT=Qextract/(m cp);Q=100kW;m=10;cp=4.18；計算 100/(10*4.18) = 2.39234 K。適用限制：無混合與其他熱源的局部降溫。~Original hypothetical teaching example: DeltaT=Qextract/(m cp);Q=100kW;m=10;cp=4.18; calculation 100/(10*4.18) = 2.39234 K. Applicability: Local cooling without mixing or other heat sources.
units.verify: 模擬污水低流量，檢查取熱後溫度與回退條件。~Simulate low sewage flow and check outlet temperature and fallback conditions.
units.failure: 以固定取熱功率運行於低流量會過度降溫。~Fixed extraction at low flow can cause excessive cooling.
units.misconception: 取出的熱量不會改變污水下游溫度。~Extracted heat does not change downstream wastewater temperature.
units.practice: 在「熱源影響與異常回退」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 2.39234 K，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「以固定取熱功率運行於低流量會過度降溫。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for source impacts and fault fallback, first reproduce 2.39234 K, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Fixed extraction at low flow can cause excessive cooling." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

place.name: 美國能源部Forrestal大樓：方法資料來源機構（非實廠）
place.nameEn: US DOE Forrestal Building: methodology source institution (not a process plant)
place.coordinateScope: 近似機構所在區域位置；依公開地址作教材地圖代表點，非建物入口、實廠、實測或導航位置。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate institution-area location inferred from its public address for the teaching map; not a building entrance, process plant, surveyed point or navigation coordinate.

history: 本課以來源所列的技術指引與研究為閱讀脈絡，並非重建某一設施的工程沿革；算例、數據與場景參數皆為原創教學假設。比較舊方法與感測、控制、資源回收整合的方法時，先固定處理功能及系統邊界，再評估效率與可靠度。~The cited technical guidance and research provide a reading pathway, not the engineering history of a particular facility. Examples, data and scene parameters are original teaching assumptions. When comparing conventional methods with integrated sensing, control and resource recovery, hold the treatment function and system boundary fixed before assessing efficiency and reliability.
